title: Lyapunov Stability and Optimal Error Estimates for an SIPG Method for Weakly Damped Semilinear Wave Equations
summary: We develop and analyze a fully discrete scheme for the weakly damped semilinear wave equation that combines a Symmetric Interior Penalty Discontinuous Galerkin (SIPG) spatial discretization with a hybrid Crank--Nicolson/second-order Backward Differentiation Formula (CN--BDF2) time integrator. A chord-slope linearization of the nonlinear reaction term is employed, which preserves an exact discrete gradient structure and, crucially, requires {no global Lipschitz continuity assumption} on the nonlinearity.
